title: Howdah event line, schema 2
description: One Howdah security event: one JSON object per line. Keys may appear in any order. New keys can be added without changing `schema`; removing, renaming or retyping a key increments it. See docs/log-schema.md.

schema.description: Version of this line format: 2 in releases after 1.4.0. Lines from 1.0 to 1.4.0 have no `schema` key (treat them as 1).

version.description: Version of the Howdah extension that wrote the line, for example "1.3.0".

ts.description: Time of the event: UTC Unix epoch milliseconds as a decimal string (a string since 1.0, kept for compatibility). "0" only in the browser demo, which has no clock.

request_id.description: Per-request id, lowercase hex. The same id is printed in the block response body, so a user's report maps to its log line. Every event from one request shares it.

layer.description: Protection layer of `rule`: 1 = request-shape limits (multipart, input shape, request headers, self-test), 2 = input inspection, 3 = sink hardening, 4 = after-breach behaviour. A future layer is added to this enum without changing `schema`.

rule.description: Rule name, the same spelling as the [rules], [inspect.rule_modes] and [sinks.<sink>] config keys. The full list is in docs/log-schema.md.

action.description: What Howdah did: "log" (recorded, request allowed), "block" (request refused or call denied), or "excepted" (a finding a [[exceptions]] entry turned off; written only when exceptions_log = true). "allow" is reserved and not written by 1.x.

client_ip.description: REMOTE_ADDR as the SAPI reports it (the proxy's address behind a reverse proxy). Empty when the SAPI has none, as on the command line.

method.description: HTTP request method. Empty when the SAPI has none.

uri.description: Request path. The query string is removed before logging, because it can carry secrets.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation. It may name a variable, function, class, host or port; it never contains a request body, cookie, Authorization header, matched value or sink argument. Its wording is not part of the contract: match on `rule`, not `reason`.
